name: db_load_all
note: allocates text pool (8aa8, size of 2 language files), loads HES 201 films (far 2489), 202 series (far 2626), 203 shows/episodes (far 713c), 204 ad customers (DS:3f2f), 205 (DS:2711, news chains), 206 news topics (DS:5573), 48 (DS:3a81 news story templates); then copies name/slogan/news strings from language files DS:0560[lang 055c] (+0x0c, +0x08) into the pool via text_pool_take; calls episodes_init_from_first

name: text_pool_take
note: copies len bytes from loaded file buffer (8f90 + read pos 11e2) to text pool (8aa8 + 11e4), stores far ptr to the string in *out, advances both positions (+len, +len+1 for NUL)

name: episodes_init_from_first
note: for each of 50 records in far DAT_713c (stride 0x1b3) with flag bit0 clear and bit2 set (+5) copies episode 1 data (0x23 B at +8) to episodes 2..10

name: money_add
note: adds amount to finance statistics long DAT_71d5[category] (= 71d1 block of 21 longs, index 0 = day-start money). NOT per player as architecture.md says: callers pass category constants 1..0xd

name: news_update
note: decrements countdown (+0x12) of the 7 running news chains (DAT_70a9, 21 B each) by elapsed, emits due news (news_chain_step(0)), refills chains, then forces news of type 1 until min_new present, finally news_distribute

name: news_count_type1
note: counts entries of today's news list (DS:36bb, 30 B each, count 7228) whose category byte (+0x1c) == 1

name: news_generate
note: appends a news item for chain idx to today's news list (max 20, drops oldest): topic, 5 text variants, price (+0x16) from topic table DS:2711 and template quality, price class (+0x1d via table DS:11e6), category, day 71c4, hour 71ca

name: news_add_special
c_signature: void news_add_special(int16_t topic, int16_t param1, int16_t param2)
note: appends fixed news (topic 0xa6..0xa8 from 2bd1 events, param1=0x10, param2=player) with category 1, price from DS:2719[topic]

name: news_chain_step
note: selects the news chain with smallest countdown <= max_time (max_time!=0: only category 1), generates its news and advances it to a random successor (9999 = chain ends); returns chain index or -1

name: news_chains_refill
note: starts new chains in empty slots of 70a9 from templates DS:3a81 (random, category-distinct), picks random text variants (news_variant_in_use)

name: news_variant_in_use
note: 1 if any running chain already uses topic/variant

name: newscast_rate
note: average of the values (+0x16) of the player's 3 newscast slots (DS:3d4b + p*0x78, 30 B each) -> DS:3f2b[player] (char)

name: auction_assign_unbid
note: for the 10 auction lots (DS:1aed, 9 B: id, long price +2, char bidder +6): lots with bidder<0 get the current player (8b88) and price += auction_bid_increment

name: message_slot_alloc
note: for the human player (8b88): increments message count 7227; if >4 drops oldest of the 26-B message list DS:609f

name: programmes_on_air_update
note: per player: programme in current hour of schedule 43f7 (skipping 9999 = continuation); in its first hour: series -> record episode in plan +0x1e, series_episode_wear, advance episode (wraps); film -> film_wear. Called at minute 5

name: schedule_day_rotate
note: copies today's schedules 43f7 -> 3919 (0x168 B), shifts hours 8..14 to 1..7 for programme/episode/ad arrays, clears 71d0, 765a, 79ee, 7a48

name: news_distribute
note: copies each item of today's news list into each player's news archive (DS:455f + p*600, 30 B entries, count 7286[p]) if the player subscribed to the category (player rec 8bbc+0x10+cat); drops oldest at 20; clears list

name: news_values_decay
note: scales values (+0x16) of player news archives by pct_archive/100 (recomputes price class via DS:11ec) and of newscast slots by pct_newscast/100

name: series_next_episode
c_signature: int16_t series_next_episode(int16_t player, int16_t series, int16_t hour)
note: episode number that the series (index into 2626) will air at given hour: current episode (+0x31) plus earlier unplayed slots of same series in schedule, wrapped by episode count

name: money_available
note: returns long (DX:AX; Ghidra shows int): player money (8bbc+8) minus stations bought today (1ce9 status 1) minus own auction bids (and unclaimed lots + increment for human player)

name: programme_remove_from_archives
note: prog<1000 film (sets state 0, flag bit5 unless genre 7), else series (prog-1000); removes it from all players' archives (6ef9, genre 0xb for series)

name: player_news_drop_oldest
note: shifts player news archive (455f + p*600) down by one, count 7286[p]--

name: player_news_remove
note: removes entry idx from player news archive

name: list5_remove
note: removes 5-byte entry idx from per-player list DS:1a25 (+p*0x32, count 7652[p]); meaning unknown

name: production_remove
note: removes 15-byte entry idx from per-player list DS:732c (+p*0x4b, count 7460[p]) (own productions: show id, episode, cast)

name: list_remove
note: removes 7-byte entry idx from per-player list DS:1b50 (+p*0x46, count 7688[p]) - ad contracts (?); mirror list DS:4ebf (+p*0x4d) for AI players 00f2/00f3

name: series_episode_wear
note: reduces topicality byte of episode (+episode*3+1) by series wear factor (+0x33) * byte /20, min 1

name: film_wear
note: film +3 (topicality) -= (+1 * +2)/5, min 1

name: auction_bid_increment
note: returns long: lot price/10 rounded down to its magnitude (10,100,1000,10000,100000); Ghidra name caseD_7, result in DX:AX
